entities.name: Madonna dell'Archetto
entities.label: Institution
entities.summary: The Church of the Madonna dell'Archetto is a small oratory in Rome, Italy, in the Trevi rione. The official title of the church is Santa Maria Causa Nostrae Laetitiae. It is often cited as being the smallest church in Rome.
